subject: Team offsite 12-13 March, 24 people
body:
Hi,

I'm organising a two-day offsite for Northwind AB on 12-13 March 2027 for 24 people. We need a meeting room with a projector both days, lunch on both days, and 12 hotel rooms for the night of the 12th. Dinner on the 12th for everyone would be great too.

Best regards,
Anna Lindqvist
Northwind AB
